scripts.lint: npm run -s check-store-reads && npm run -s check-routes-only && npm run -s check-test-only-imports && oxlint && oxfmt --check
scripts.check-store-reads: ! grep -rnoE '\b[A-Za-z_$]+Store\(' apps/mobile/src --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' | grep -v 'useStore($' || { echo 'Read bound zustand stores through useStore(fooStore, selector), or fooStore.getState()/setState()/subscribe().'; false; }
scripts.check-routes-only: ! find apps/mobile/src/app \( -name '*.test.*' -o -name '*.spec.*' -o -name '__tests__' \) | grep -q . || { echo 'apps/mobile/src/app is routes-only: expo-router registers every file there as a route and Metro bundles it. Move tests to src/test or next to the screen.'; false; }
scripts.check-test-only-imports: ! grep -rl 'expo-router/testing-library' apps/mobile/src --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' | grep -v '\.test\.' | grep -q . || { echo 'Import expo-router/testing-library only from *.test.* files: it pulls Node built-ins such as path into the app bundle.'; false; }
